name: fuzue
description: Party game 3D online para jogar com amigos no navegador.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @fuzue/server" "npm run dev -w @fuzue/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fuzue/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fuzue/server && npm run typecheck -w @fuzue/client
